event.title: Wreckage
event.text: The remains of a battle drift through the cluster: twisted hull plates, shattered weapon mounts, frozen debris. Your squad's converters could turn a lot of it into Mawjig.

outcome.text: Your converters hum for hours, converting enough of the matter into energy to fill your Mawjig stores.
Something in the wreckage is still armed. It goes off against your hull.

event.title: A Hidden Cache
event.text: Your sensors find a sealed container tucked into an asteroid's shadow, marked with a pirate gang's sign.

outcome.text: Inside is a weapon, still in its packing.
It's booby-trapped. The blast scorches your ship.

event.title: A Derelict
event.text: A GATOS scout cruiser hangs dead in space, its crew long gone. Its hull is holed, but its core still reads stable. With enough work it could fly again.

choice.text: Get it flying and add it to the squad.

outcome.text: It takes every spare part you can scrape together, but the old scout's Jigawatt Drive finally wakes. Its sealed stasis bay held three of its crew, alive, and they are ready to fly with you.
You strip the derelict and convert it.

event.title: A Supply Drop
event.text: A GATOS relay beacon is broadcasting free repair supplies for any ship that needs them, "while stocks last."

outcome.text: Your crews patch the worst of the damage.

event.title: Rich Dust
event.text: A dense, dark cloud of dust is drifting through this cluster, heavy with metals. Every ship that passes through it can scoop up some matter.

outcome.text: Your converters run hot. It's slow work, but it pays.

event.title: A Frame Graveyard
event.text: A Mecha frame graveyard: black hulls stacked in neat rows, stripped of anything useful. The Mecha are tidy about their dead. But someone missed a weapon pod.

outcome.text: The pod's weapon is still in working order.

event.title: Spore Bloom
event.text: A cloud of drifting Azurethea spores glitters in the light of the local star. It's beautiful, and the matter in it could be converted.

outcome.text: The spores clog your systems. Your crew spend hours clearing them out.
